package.description: Python frame stack sampler for CPython

en-US.description: Python frame stack sampler for CPython
en-US.name: Austin
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's New
- Added support for CPython 3.15.
- Dropped support for CPython 3.9.
- Added support for free-threaded CPython builds.
- Added the --native/-n option to collect native call stacks alongside Python stacks on Linux (x86_64 and aarch64), macOS and Windows (x86_64); non-Python threads are sampled too.
- Added asyncio support for CPython 3.14 and above.
- Added the Python thread names to the collected samples.
- Improved support for Linux containers.
- Added the cwd, venv and pythonpath metadata fields to help tools resolve file paths.
- Improved performance with the detection of repeated stacks and buffered output, allowing for higher sampling rates and smaller output files.

Bugfixes
- Improved CPython detection on MacOS.
- Fixed a bug that caused Austin to fail to sample a newly spawned process on MacOS.
